links.outcome: Self-rated AI knowledge and interest in learning among radiation therapists
links.effect: 37.8% rated their AI knowledge as none or limited; 93.2% expressed interest in learning more about AI; online modules (36.5%) and in-person workshops (35.1%) were the preferred educational supports.
links.quote: Additionally, 37.8 % rated their knowledge of AI as none or limited, but 93.2 % expressed interest in learning more about AI.

screen.reason: Cross-sectional survey of radiation therapists assessing their knowledge, attitudes, perceived workflow impacts, and educational needs regarding AI implementation.
